    FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

    HEAT PUMPS: COMFORT ALL YEAR ROUND

    Keeping your home warm in winter and cool in summer is essential, and at ATL, we understand how important it is to have a system you can depend on. We work with trusted brands like Mitsubishi Electric and Daikin, offering solutions designed specifically for New Zealand homes.

     

    Not sure which system suits your property? Our experts provide free on-site consultations throughout Christchurch. We’ll listen to your needs, assess your space, and recommend a heat pump or ventilation system that matches your lifestyle.

     

    All our installers are trained and approved by our brand partners, ensuring professional installation and warranty coverage. With ATL Heat Pumps, you’ll enjoy peace of mind knowing your system is installed by knowledgeable technicians who prioritise safety, efficiency, and cleanliness.

    HEAT PUMPS: COMFORT ALL YEAR ROUND

    At ATL Electrical, we understand that no two homes are the same. If a standard split system isn’t the right fit, our team will find a solution that works. We can customise installations with options like extended pipe runs and condensate pumps, ensuring your heat pump performs efficiently in any setup.

     

    For those looking for comprehensive climate control, we also offer ducted heat pump systems. These systems provide consistent heating and cooling throughout your home, giving you ultimate comfort no matter the season.

     

    Our team works closely with you, from consultation to installation, ensuring you’re fully satisfied with the result. Let ATL Heat Pumps keep your home’s climate comfortable all year round.
